name: Commander Call-ins
author: Sixth Front
description: T calls an airstrike where you aim: a line of bombs lands after the red smoke. Y brings in a squad of four reinforcements next to you. The enemy commander calls airstrikes on your team too.
script: // Hooks used: bindKey, raycast, after, every, explode, effect, spawnBot, removeBot, hud.text, banner
api.effect('smoke', x, api.heightAt(x, z) + 0.5, z, { size: 1.6, color: '#d24a3a' });
// bombs land on roofs as well as the ground
const hit = api.raycast({ x: bx, y: api.heightAt(bx, bz) + 90, z: bz }, { x: 0, y: -1, z: 0 }, 140);
api.explode(bx, hit.y + 0.3, bz, { radius: 8, damage: 180, structural: 420, vehicle: 450, owner, name: 'AIRSTRIKE' });
const a = strikeAt > t ? `AIRSTRIKE ${Math.ceil(strikeAt - t)}s` : 'AIRSTRIKE READY [T]';
const b = squadAt > t ? `SQUAD ${Math.ceil(squadAt - t)}s` : 'SQUAD READY [Y]';
api.hud.text('callins', a + '     ' + b, { x: 50, y: 19, size: 0.62, color: '#e8eae3' });
if (!P || P.state !== 'alive' || api.time() < strikeAt) { api.sound('click'); return; }
const hit = api.raycast(P.eye(api.vec()), P.forward(api.vec()), 450, { ignore: P });
if (!P || P.state !== 'alive' || api.time() < squadAt) { api.sound('click'); return; }
const bot = api.spawnBot(P.team, { x: P.pos.x + Math.cos(a) * 3, z: P.pos.z + Math.sin(a) * 3 });
// Reinforcements don't redeploy: they leave the battle when they die
// The enemy commander strikes back now and then
strike(t.pos.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10, t.pos.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10, { x: Math.cos(a), z: Math.sin(a) }, enemies[0]);
